translations.literal: After several years he lost his office for breaking the law.
translations.idiomatic: A few years later he lost his post for a legal offense.

translations.zh: 家居長安中，諸公莫不稱，由是復為代相。
translations.literal: He lived at home in Chang'an, where no eminent man failed to praise him; on that account he was appointed chancellor of Dai again.
translations.idiomatic: He lived in Chang'an, where every notable sang his praises; he was therefore made chancellor of Dai once more.

translations.zh: 武帝即位，以為淮陽天下郊，勁兵處，故徙夫為淮陽太守。
translations.literal: When Emperor Wu mounted the throne, because Huaiyang was the suburban domain of the realm and a place of crack troops, Fu was therefore transferred to be prefect of Huaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu took the throne, he judged Huaiyang the empire's suburban heartland and a garrison of crack troops, and transferred Guan Fu there as prefect.

translations.literal: He entered court as grand marshal of the imperial stud.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to court as grand marshal of the imperial stud.

translations.zh: 二年，夫與長樂衛尉竇甫飲，輕重不得，夫醉，搏甫。
translations.literal: In the second year, Fu drank with Chamberlain for the Changle Palace Guard Dou Fu; they could not match each other in weight of cups; Fu, drunk, struck Fu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Guan Fu drank with Chamberlain for the Changle Palace Guard Dou Fu; neither would yield in the drinking contest; drunk, Guan Fu struck him.

translations.literal: Fu was the empress dowager Dou's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Fu was Empress Dowager Dou's younger brother.

translations.zh: 上恐太后誅夫，徙夫為燕相。
translations.literal: The emperor feared the empress dowager would execute Fu and transferred Fu to be chancellor of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor feared the empress dowager would have Guan Fu executed and transferred him to be chancellor of Yan.

translations.literal: After several years he was dismissed for breaking the law and lived at home in Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: A few years later he was dismissed for a legal offense and lived in retirement in Chang'an.
